calculation.description: Fade the completed day's open-to-close directional shock, normalized by prior 20-session true-range average. The factor is available only after the bar closes and is ranked cross-sectionally.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC and positive decay-horizon IC across the available validation sample; effective dates are limited and coverage is incomplete, so this is a monitored candidate rather than a dominant ensemble input.

signal_provenance.forward_return_alignment: close_t to close_{t+h}; ATR is shifted one session
